meta_description: Westways Landscapes in Leicester designs and builds stunning gardens. Expert planting, patios, and maintenance. Free quotes available.
hero_eyebrow: Award-Winning Garden Design — 12+ Years Creating Outdoor Spaces
hero_subhead: Whether you want a low-maintenance patio or a vibrant planted border, Westways Landscapes brings your outdoor vision to life.
services_heading: Complete Garden Design & Landscaping Across Leicester
services_subhead: From initial concept to final planting, we handle every aspect of creating an outdoor space you'll love.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke designs tailored to your budget and lifestyle. We create detailed plans, handle council permissions where needed, and visualise your garden before work begins.

services.title: Patios & Hard Landscaping
services.desc: Professionally laid block paving, Indian stone, and porcelain surfaces. Built to last with proper foundations and drainage — perfect for entertaining or simply enjoying your space.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Thoughtful plant selection for year-round colour and minimal upkeep. We source quality specimens and design borders that thrive in your garden's conditions.

services.title: Decking Installation
services.desc: Durable wooden or composite decking, custom-built and sealed. Creates an instant outdoor room for relaxation and entertaining.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular upkeep including lawn care, pruning, and seasonal tidying. Keep your garden thriving with weekly or monthly visits tailored to your needs.

services.title: Fencing & Screening
services.desc: Quality fence installation and replacement, plus privacy screens and trellis work. Protects your space while adding structure and character.

about_pullquote: Every garden tells a story. We build the ones our neighbours want to show off.
about_para_1: Westways Landscapes was founded in 2012 by a team of horticulturists and builders fed up with one-size-fits-all garden services. We began with a simple belief: a good garden should reflect who you are, work with your soil and sunlight, and last for years without constant fuss. Over a decade, we've transformed over 450 gardens across Leicester and the surrounding areas, earning a reputation for honest advice and meticulous attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen first and sell second. We never push unnecessary work, and we're upfront about costs and timelines from the start. Whether you need a complete overhaul or seasonal maintenance, we treat your garden as seriously as you do. Many of our clients have been with us since our first year — that's the kind of long-term relationship we're built on.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Westways

reviews.text: We had a overgrown mess of a back garden that we didn't know where to start with. Mark came round, listened to what we actually wanted, and produced a brilliant design. The lads built it beautifully over three weeks. It's become our favourite room in the house. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Had the patio replaced and new borders put in. Very tidy workers, cleared up after themselves every day. The quality of the stone and the finish is excellent. Fair price too. Will be having them back for the fence next year.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Been using Westways for maintenance for three years now. Rob comes every other week and the garden just looks after itself. He knows what should stay and what should go. Much better than the last lot we had. Professional and friendly.
reviews.author: Jennifer T.
